prompt: Quick check of this repo. Use exactly two sub-agents in parallel: one lists every function defined in ledgerlite/money.py with a one-line description, the other does the same for ledgerlite/report.py. Then combine their findings into a short summary. Do not modify any files.

Add complete type hints and a dedicated test module for each of ledgerlite/parse.py, ledgerlite/money.py, ledgerlite/storage.py and ledgerlite/report.py. Delegate one module to each sub-agent, running them in parallel, and give each the context it needs; then integrate, run python -m pytest -q, and fix anything that fails.

Audit this codebase for bugs. Assign one sub-agent per module (parse, money, storage, report, cli) to find and fix defects in that module and add a regression test for each fix, running them in parallel. Then integrate their work and run the test suite.

Implement multi-currency support: transactions carry a currency code, amounts are formatted per currency, reports group totals by currency, and the CSV importer accepts an optional currency column defaulting to USD. Split the work across at least three sub-agents by module, run them in parallel, then integrate and test.

Write docstrings for every public function and a docs/ directory with one markdown page per module explaining its API and edge cases. Use one sub-agent per module in parallel, then write docs/index.md yourself linking the pages.

Replace the single-command CLI with subcommands: import <csv>, report [--month YYYY-MM], and export <path> (writes CSV). Delegate each subcommand to a sub-agent in parallel, then integrate, add tests for the CLI, and update the README.

Introduce a custom exception hierarchy (LedgerError with ParseError, StorageError, ReportError) and structured logging via the logging module across all modules. Delegate per module to sub-agents in parallel, then integrate and make sure the CLI reports errors cleanly.

Review this codebase from three angles using three parallel sub-agents: correctness, security and robustness, and code style and maintainability. Each should write concrete findings with file and line references. Combine them into REVIEW.md ordered by severity. Do not change source files.

The importer and the report renderer are too slow on a 200k-row export. Use two sub-agents in parallel: one to profile and optimise ledgerlite/parse.py, the other ledgerlite/report.py, each adding a benchmark script under bench/. Then integrate and confirm the tests still pass.

Imports of the same bank export twice currently double-count transactions. Design and implement idempotent imports: a stable transaction fingerprint, deduplication on import, and a --force flag to bypass it. Split fingerprinting, storage changes, and CLI/tests across three parallel sub-agents, then integrate.
